```
RMA-8421: AWB123456789 -> SN: H100-NE-0001, H100-NE-0002
RMA-8421-2: AWB123456790 -> SN: H100-NE-0003..H100-NE-0018
```

maya: action list: 1) maya — PO amend + finance follow-up; 2) gabriel — get new AWBs & RMA manifest; 3) leah — prep crossdock + depot intake; 4) henry — routing updates; 5) sophie — smoke tests. i'll follow up in 24h.
